newsitem.title: USA: ROC raises stake in Chateau Properties.
newsitem.headline: ROC raises stake in Chateau Properties.

text.p: ROC Communities Inc said Thursday it raised its stake in Chateau Properties Inc to 797,115 common shares or 12.2 percent from 8.7 percent held previously.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, ROC said it bought 231,300 common shares on October 16 at $25.50 per share.

However, ROC continues to disclaim beneficial ownership of 447,115 of those common shares. Such percentage is based on 6,099,710 outstanding shares, plus 420,000 shares subject to the Chateau option, the filing said.
As previously reported, ROC has agreed with Chateau to vote all such shares in favor of their proposed merger, the filing said.

Last month, Chateau's board unanimously approved a revised merger agreement with ROC. Under the agreement, each Chateau share would represent 1.0316 shares of the resulting combined company. The exchange ratio for ROC is unchanged at 1.042.
Chateau Properties and ROC are both real estate investment trusts operating in the manufacturing housing community industry. The new company would be renamed Chateau Communities Inc.
Chateau is also the target of a hostile bid by Manufactured Home Communities Inc, also a real estate investment trust.
Earlier this month in a letter to Chateau, MHC chairman Sam Zell said MHC was prepared to include a tax-deferred option for operating partnership unit holders and an enhanced cash offer.
However, Chateau said it has "determined it would not be appropriate to enter into discussions" with Manufactured Homes.
